bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
health="$(timeout 45s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health 2>&1 || true)"
chat="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py chat_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
invite="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
{ echo "USERBOT_SELECTOR_DIAGNOSTICS"; echo "HEALTH_RESULT=$(printf '%s' "$health" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)";echo "HEALTH_ERROR=$(printf '%s' "$health" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=' | head -1 || echo NONE)";echo "CHAT_RESULT=$(printf '%s' "$chat" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)";echo "CHAT_ERROR=$(printf '%s' "$chat" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=' | head -1 || echo NONE)";echo "INVITE_RESULT=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)";echo "INVITE_ERROR=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=' | head -1 || echo NONE)";echo "ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)";echo "ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)";echo "BOT_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
